**How to falsify it:** Identification of individuals with pathogenic variants in FANCL exhibiting only phenotypes distinct from Fanconi Anemia group 10, or vice versa, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Exclusion of common variants in a significant portion of the population (e.g., gnomAD allele frequency > 0.001) in the coding regions of FANCL and FAAP100 associated with these diseases.)_
